name: Core Pack
desc: The standard chaos pack for Season 1.

cards.title: Lost Luggage
cards.desc: A superstar arrives without their gear and must compete in street clothes.

cards.title: Under the Weather
cards.desc: A minor illness lowers performance for 1 show.

cards.title: Fan Gift
cards.desc: A small morale boost for a superstar (+1 crowd reaction for 1 show).

cards.title: Bad Promo
cards.desc: A poor promo hurts heat slightly for 1 show.

cards.title: Travel Delay
cards.desc: Late arrival reduces match readiness this show.

cards.title: Underdog Push
cards.desc: Short-term push: +3 momentum for the next 2 shows.

cards.title: Sneak Attack
cards.desc: Interfere to injure opponent, opponent suffers -2 performance for 2 shows.

cards.title: Title Scramble
cards.desc: Make a mid-card title open for a scramble match this show.

cards.title: Rocket Push
cards.desc: A big crowd moment: +4 momentum for 1 show but increases scrutiny.

cards.title: Wardrobe Mishap
cards.desc: Outfit problem leads to a flub; -1 performance this show.

cards.title: Medical Suspension
cards.desc: A medical suspension sidelines a rival for 3 shows.

cards.title: Extreme Rules Month
cards.desc: All matches this month use hardcore rules; some superstars gain advantage.

cards.title: Local Hero Boost
cards.desc: A hometown crowd gives a small boost this show.

cards.title: Logistics Mix-Up
cards.desc: Promo materials delayed; minor show quality drop.

cards.title: Superstar Starter
cards.desc: Give a rookie a spotlight match with potential long-term gain.

cards.title: Controversial Angle
cards.desc: A controversial storyline generates heat but risks penalties.

cards.title: Equipment Failure
cards.desc: Ring equipment glitch causes minor chaos, affecting match pacing.

cards.title: Main Event Elevation
cards.desc: Promote a mid-card act to main event status for 2 shows.

cards.title: Power Play
cards.desc: Executive interference grants a dominant champion run for 4 shows.

cards.title: Surprise Debut
cards.desc: A surprise arrival shakes up the roster this show.

cards.title: Training Montage
cards.desc: A week of focused training improves performance next show.

cards.title: Media Day Gone Wrong
cards.desc: An awkward interview reduces crowd reaction for a show.

cards.title: Brand Split Advantage
cards.desc: Shifting the roster favors certain superstars for 3 shows.

cards.title: Household Name
cards.desc: A star-making moment that gives sustained momentum for 5 shows.

cards.title: Match Type Switch
cards.desc: Change a scheduled match to a specialty match this show.

cards.title: Sponsor Boost
cards.desc: A sponsor gives extra exposure; +2 momentum for 2 shows.

cards.title: Cheap Shot
cards.desc: A backstage attack tanks the opponent for the show.

cards.title: Venue Controversy
cards.desc: A venue incident causes a PR hit; show quality down for 3 shows.
